Sam R: Hi all, day 3 question — trying to map who owns what for inference outages so I know who to ping. Specifically: LB/edge 504s, model regressions, Dedicated capacity, and billing. Any compact owner list I can paste into my notes?

Elena: Welcome Sam! :wave: Short owner map we keep in the playbook: LB/edge & host network -> eng-infra, alerting/oncall triage -> eng-sre, model routing/pinning/variants -> eng-runtime, model quality/evals -> eng-ml, Dedicated capacity & billing -> eng-platform.

Sam R: Nice. Channels or people to mention? Don't want to spam leaders.

Priya: Channels: #eng-infra, #eng-sre, #eng-runtime, #eng-platform. For paging: `@eng-sre-oncall` and `@runtime-oncall` are the rotations. For Dedicated billing issues email eng-platform-saas@redwood.com and CC your AM/CSM.

Elena: Quick triage checklist before paging: 1) get request-id + trace-id 2) run redwoodctl traces get <trace-id> 3) check route with `redwoodctl route get --customer <id>` 4) capture recent 5xxs. If it's clearly routing variant mismatch tag #eng-runtime.

Sam R: Is there an approved emergency rollback template?

Priya: Yes — post to #eng-runtime with this exact text: `EMERGENCY ROLLBACK cust=<id> req=<req-id> reason=<latency|regression|capacity> action=pin:<model>@<version>` then tag `@runtime-oncall`. That speeds things up.

Elena: Also include a sample input and the failing response when you page. The bots attach traces automatically if you paste the request-id in the page.

platform-bot: REMINDER: For Dedicated capacity questions include customer contract ID and usage window. Eng-platform will not join without those.

Sam R: Good to know. One more: if we suspect a kernel/GPU failure (OOMs), who to page?

Elena: Page @infra-oncall in #eng-infra and include `infractl host status --zone <z>` output + `dmesg` snippet. If it's a Dedicated customer's host, CC eng-platform.

devex: If you want, I can add this trimmed owner-map to the new-hire checklist card and include the rollback template. Ping me and I'll make the PR.

Sam R: Please do — I'll send my notes. Thanks everyone, that clarifies who to ping. :thumbsup:
